name: Voodoo Dolls
description: Just in time for Halloween 2024 @superbeasts_ai brings you cursed and creepy voodoo dolls. Suggested to use "Voodoo doll" and "Plush toy" Actual trigger words from the training are "VoodooV2", "SB172ID" so if you want to push it even harder please use those as well. I've included some basic examples as well so you can see the difference a more complex prompt can make. Examples created for Flux1 Dev all sample images using FP16 with a Lora weight of 1.0 Trained with over 70 original images created in Flux to capture creepy cursed voodoo dolls. Share your images here, I'd love to see what you can create with this Lora. For my standard beastly content check me out on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/superbeasts.ai
